topic: Identity fallback in quantum synthesis fitness causes false local optimum
principle: Never use the identity matrix as a fallback return value for unrecognized or malformed quantum circuits in a fidelity-based fitness function. Any circuit, no matter how random, will score F = Tr(I^dag @ U_target)/N = 0.75 for a 3-qubit target, creating a dominant local optimum that the search cannot escape.
instruction: I'm evolving quantum circuits and my search always converges to fidelity 0.75 no matter what I try
